response.text: {"name":"Tabela ostrine","idea":"The homepage reads like the optometrist's acuity chart: the type steps down from huge to small, row by row, each row perfectly sharp, because this shop measures sight and makes the glasses in its own workshop within three working days.","palette":[{"role":"background","hex":"#ffffff"},{"role":"text","hex":"#14181d"},{"role":"muted","hex":"#5b6470"},{"role":"primary","hex":"#1b3fb8"},{"role":"onPrimary","hex":"#f3f6fc"},{"role":"border","hex":"#d6dae1"},{"role":"inverse","hex":"#111418"},{"role":"onInverse","hex":"#eef1f5"}],"pairing":"archivo-archivo","typeCharacter":"Archivo at display sizes is wide, crisp and almost clinical, like the letters on a test chart; headings in Archivo Black or ExtraBold, sentence case, tight leading, the h1 at about 11vw; running text in Archivo Regular at 1.15rem with generous line height; service names in Archivo SemiBold at about 2.4vw; all labels sentence case, no tracking, no uppercase.","composition":"Section 1, hero, white ground, 4 rows, a thin #d6dae1 vertical rule running down the left edge of column 1 for the whole section like a ruled margin. Row 1: h1 'Očala po meri v treh dneh' in Archivo Black at about 11vw on two lines, columns 1 to 12, left aligned, ink #14181d; in columns 10 to 12 a simple line drawing of two circles joined by a short bridge (spectacle lenses) in cobalt #1b3fb8, stroke about 3px, its left circle overlapping the last letters of the h1 by a few pixels. Row 2: the lead in Archivo Regular at about 2.1vw, columns 1 to 7, muted #5b6470, separated from row 1 by a hairline rule across columns 1 to 12. Row 3: a ribbon of short words at 1.1rem across columns 1 to 12, 'Pregled vida · Okvirji · Očala po meri · Kontaktne leče · Sončna očala z dioptrijo · Očala za računalnik · Naročilnice ZZZS', ink, separated by small cobalt dots, another hairline above. Row 4: one button, cobalt field, onPrimary text, square corners, 'Naročite se po e-pošti', columns 1 to 3. Each row is a smaller line of the chart, all left aligned on the ruled margin. Section 2, highlights, full width cobalt #1b3fb8 band, 4 rows, text #f3f6fc: the four highlights as four left aligned lines stepping down in size, row 1 'Očala naredimo v lastni delavnici, večinoma v treh delovnih dneh' at about 4.5vw columns 1 to 11, row 2 'Pregled vida je brezplačen, če kupite očala pri nas' at about 3.4vw columns 1 to 10, row 3 'Sprejemamo naročilnice ZZZS za otroke in odrasle' at about 2.6vw columns 1 to 9, row 4 'Okvir lahko izberete tudi brez naročila' at about 2vw columns 1 to 8; hairline rules in #f3f6fc at 40 percent between rows. Section 3, services, white ground, 8 rows: heading 'Kaj vse vam nudimo' at about 4vw columns 1 to 6 in row 1; rows 2 to 8 one offering each as a ruled table line, name in Archivo SemiBold 2.4vw columns 1 to 5, description in Regular 1.15rem columns 6 to 11 where given, a hairline #d6dae1 under each row; for offerings without a description the name stands alone. Section 4, hours, white ground, 2 rows: heading 'Kdaj nas najdete v Postojni' at 3.2vw columns 1 to 4; the opening hours as a week strip columns 5 to 12, day abbreviations in SemiBold, times in Regular, cobalt rule above the strip, closed days in muted. Section 5, team, white ground, 2 rows: heading 'Kdo vas sprejme' at 3.2vw columns 1 to 4; the one named person and role in running text columns 5 to 9; in columns 10 to 12 a single cobalt line circle, about 14vw across, a lens, no face. Section 6, contact, inverse near black #111418 full width, text #eef1f5, 3 rows: heading 'Pišite nam za termin pregleda' at 4vw columns 1 to 7; lead 'Pišite nam in dogovorite se za termin pregleda vida.' columns 1 to 6; email address in Archivo SemiBold at about 3vw columns 1 to 8 as the only link, no phone numeral since no phone is given; address 'Tržaška cesta 18, 6230 Postojna' columns 1 to 4 in row 3; a simple schematic map, white lines on the dark field, columns 7 to 12 spanning rows 2 and 3. On phones every section stacks in one column keeping the left ruled margin in the hero.","imagery":"No photographs anywhere.
